description: This file implements event handling functionality for a system that communicates over ubus, including registering events, sending events, and processing incoming ubus events within the context of a specific application related to bbfdm (Broadband Device Management).

methods.name: char * get_events_dm_path(struct list_head * ev_list,const char * event)
methods.description: Retrieves the data model path associated with a specific event name from a list of event handlers.

methods.name: void event_callback(const void * arg1,void * arg2)
methods.description: Callback function called to send a generated event via ubus.

methods.name: void bbfdm_event_handler(struct ubus_context * ctx,struct ubus_event_handler * ev,const char * type,struct blob_attr * msg)
methods.description: Handles incoming ubus events, processes them, and executes corresponding commands.

methods.name: void add_ubus_event_handler(struct ubus_event_handler * ev,const char * ev_name,const char * dm_path,struct list_head * ev_list)
methods.description: Adds a new ubus event handler to the list of handlers.

methods.name: int register_events_to_ubus(struct ubus_context * ctx,struct list_head * ev_list)
methods.description: Registers event handlers with ubus based on schema retrieved from the system.

methods.name: void free_ubus_event_handler(struct ubus_context * ctx,struct list_head * ev_list)
methods.description: Frees the list of registered ubus event handlers and unregisters them from ubus.
